newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar says Morrison shares tendered.
newsitem.headline: Northstar says Morrison shares tendered.

text.p: Northstar Energy Corp said on Monday that 63,250,095 common shares of Morrison Petroleums Ltd, or about 96.8 percent of the total number of shares outstanding, were tendered by Morrison shareholders in response to Northstar's takeover bid.

Northstar and its wholly owned Northstar Acquisition Corp (NAC) said all the conditions of their offer were satisfied and all the Morrison common shares deposited under the offer were taken up and paid for.
Northstar and NAC said they would begin acquiring all shares not tendered pursuant to the compulsory acquisition provisions available legally.
"We are delighted with the positive response by Morrison shareholders to our bid," Northstar Chief Executive John Hagg said.
"The overwhelming acceptance of the offer reflects the strategic fit of these two strong companies and will allow us to proceed without delay with the integration of our operations," Hagg added.
He said Northstar would proceed immediately with its previously announced substantial issuer bid, expected to be mailed by about March 21.
